description: Perform the annual database maintenance workflow for Jolly Lobby Track. First, create a backup of the current visitor database (containing 2025 records) and save it to '/home/ga/Documents/VisitorLog_2025_Archive' (any database backup format like .bak, .mdb, or .zip is acceptable). Second, purge/delete ALL visitor log records from the active system to reset it for the new year, ensuring the visitor log grid is empty. Do NOT delete Employee/Host records. Finally, to verify the purge, export the now-empty visitor log to a CSV file named '/home/ga/Documents/verification_empty_log.csv'.
